Subject: POC trial planning - Zenotech

Hi Jason —

Great to connect on the discovery call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the POC kickoff: 

Recap (from our call)
- Primary use case: summarize and classify customer support tickets to accelerate triage and routing.
- Target scope: 6 months of historical ticket data (~150k rows) + live test set.
- Success criteria (proposed):
  1) Extraction accuracy: >= 85% on entity extraction for priority fields (product, issue_type).
  2) Classification F1 >= 0.80 on triage labels.
  3) End-to-end latency <= 250 ms p95 for single-request inference in the test harness.
  4) Cost target: average inference cost <= $0.015 per 1k tokens during evaluation.

Proposed POC plan / timeline
- Kickoff: week of Aug 2 (propose Tue Aug 3, 10:00 AM PT)
- Initial setup & data ingest: 1 week (Aug 3–Aug 10)
- Evaluation run + tuning: 3 weeks (Aug 11–Aug 31)
- Final readout: Thu Sep 2 (presentation of results, next-steps discussion)

Ownership
- Redwood: Marissa (sales owner) and Dev Patel (solutions engineer) — setup, model config, runbooks
- Zenotech: Jason (product lead) and Priya Shah (data/ops) — provide sample data, infra access, success criteria sign-off

Attachments: POC_Timeline_v1.docx, POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (see attached stubs)

Next steps / Asks
1) Confirm internal attendees for kickoff and preferred kickoff date/time.
2) Share a representative sample of the ticket dataset (CSV or S3 link) and a safe test set by Friday Jul 23.
3) Point of contact for procurement/DocuSign so we can send the POC SOW/engagement agreement.
4) Any security/compliance requirements we should prep for (SOC2, IP/data residency)?

If that all looks good I'll send a calendar invite and loop in Dev and Neha for the technical prep session.

Thanks —
Marissa

Quick technical checklist from our side — happy to go over on the kickoff call or schedule a separate 30-min tech run through before kickoff:

1) Representative dataset: CSV or S3 link (sample of ~5k rows, includes ticket_id, text, created_at, labels)
2) Data access: read-only S3 credentials OR secure share (preferred: pre-signed URL). If Zenotech prefers VPC/private deployment, we'll need network details and a contact for infra.
3) Test API key: we'll provision a test key scoped to the POC environment.
4) If you want to validate latency from a specific region, please confirm desired region (us-west-2 / us-east-1 / eu-west-1).
5) Expected peak concurrency for evaluation (~rps) — if you expect > 50 rps we should plan dedicated capacity.

Estimate: 2-3 hours to wire up data ingest + a first smoke test once we have sample data and credentials.

I'll prepare a short runbook we can attach to the kickoff invite (includes endpoints, example payloads, evaluation harness).

— Dev
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
